states.title: Two agents establish a contract
states.detail: They agree on the task, its constraints, and its completion conditions.

states.title: Each agent signs the agreement
states.detail: The same contract binds both sides.

states.title: Both agents have signed
states.detail: Execution can now begin under the agreed contract.

states.title: The executing agent runs inside the Airlock
states.detail: The signed contract governs access to external resources. Payment is held.

states.title: Each tool call must carry a proof
states.detail: The agent submits a proposed email action and its proof for checking.

states.title: Proof rejected — action blocked
states.detail: The tool is not called. External resources remain unchanged.

states.title: The agent revises its proposal
states.detail: A new action and proof are submitted to the same checking point.

states.title: Proof accepted — email tool called
states.detail: Only after the check succeeds is access permitted. The result is recorded.

states.title: The next action also needs a proof
states.detail: Access to the database requires a separate checked tool call.

states.title: Proof accepted — database tool called
states.detail: The agent stays inside the Airlock. A second result is recorded.

states.title: The agent calls the final check
states.detail: The settlement call carries a proof of completion, supported by the execution record.

states.title: Completion is verified against the contract
states.detail: The final check establishes that the agreed completion conditions hold.

states.title: The Airlock releases the payment
states.detail: Payment is released to the contractor after successful verification of completion.
